fusions.name: Reedbed Lunge
fusions.desc: You lunge up to 6 tiles to the target and bite it for 14 damage, with 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been wounded.

fusions.name: Clamping Jaw
fusions.desc: Clamps onto the target for 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaving it 15% easier to wound and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Log
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 10%. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Coiled Below
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next spell deals 40% more damage. Once every 10 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
